name: Stock photo, video & illustration contributor
summary: Upload your photos, video clips or illustrations to Shutterstock's library and earn a percentage each time a customer licenses one.
whatYouDo: You shoot or create images, footage or vectors, add titles and keywords, and submit them for review. Approved files stay in the library and earn a royalty each time they're downloaded, so income builds slowly and depends on a large portfolio of subjects buyers want.
appeal: Free to join, and you work whenever you like
Uses skills and gear you may already have (camera, phone, design software)
Approved files can keep earning for a long time without new effort
Earnings levels go up from 15% to 40% of the sale as your downloads grow within a year
watchOuts: Earnings per download are small: Shutterstock pays 15% to 40% of the sale depending on your level, and some downloads pay only the $0.10 minimum
Levels reset to Level 1 every January 1, so even busy contributors drop back to the lowest rate each year
The 2020 switch to this percentage model cut typical subscription-download pay sharply and caused contributor backlash (Amateur Photographer, Fstoppers)
Contributors report more files earning fewer sales as libraries grow and AI images compete (contributor blog, 2026)
Non-US contributors need an approved W-8BEN tax form before being paid. Without a treaty rate, 30% can be withheld on licences bought by US customers
Trustpilot reviewers (2025, anecdotal) describe accounts closed with earnings held. Shutterstock says closing an account that still has a balance can take up to 90 days

training.notes: No required training; contributors must follow Shutterstock's content submission guidelines.

compensation.notes: Official help centre: 6 earnings levels each for images and video, from 15% to 40% of the sale, reset to Level 1 on 1 January; some downloads pay the $0.10 minimum (currency not stated in indexed text). 2020 coverage listed thresholds of up to 100 downloads (15%) through 25,001+ (40%); current thresholds not confirmed. Monthly payouts by the 15th once a minimum payout amount is reached (one third-party blog says $35, unverified). No typical income figure is published; treat as small, irregular side income.

reliability.notes: Income depends on buyer downloads, not hours worked. Contributor blogs and journalism describe falling per-file returns since 2020 and growing AI competition.

applicationSteps: Register for a Shutterstock contributor account with your full legal name (18+)
Read the contributor account and content submission guidelines
Upload files with titles and keywords and wait for review
Submit a W-8BEN tax form (non-US individuals) and set up payout so you can be paid monthly
fitsIf: You already take good photos or videos or make illustrations and want a low-effort side outlet, without counting on the money.
notFitIf: You need predictable income soon; most contributors earn little per file and sales are slow.

sources.title: How much will I be paid as a contributor to Shutterstock?
sources.notes: Search summary: 6 separate earnings levels for images and for videos, from 15% up to 40%, based on download counts; all levels reset to Level 1 on 1 January each year. Page not opened.

sources.title: Why am I still seeing $0.10 earnings at higher levels?
sources.notes: Search summary: when the percentage payout is less than $0.10, Shutterstock rounds the payment up to a $0.10 minimum. Page not opened.

sources.title: How do I get paid for my work?
sources.notes: Search summary: payments issued monthly by the 15th to contributors who meet a minimum payout amount (figure not shown in summary). Page not opened.

sources.title: Is there a minimum age for contributors?
sources.notes: Search summary: contributors must be 18 or older; parents cannot open accounts for children. Page not opened.

sources.title: W-8BEN tax form frequently asked questions
sources.notes: Search summary: non-US contributors may face 30% withholding on licences bought by US customers, lower or zero with a tax treaty; no payment without an approved tax form; forms older than 3 years must be replaced. Implies non-US (treaty-country) contributors are accepted; Canada not named. Page not opened.

sources.title: How do I cancel or close my contributor account?
sources.notes: Search summary: accounts with an outstanding balance cannot self-delete; Shutterstock arranges the final payout and closure can take up to 90 days. Page not opened.

sources.title: What's wrong with Shutterstock
sources.notes: Search summary: June 2020 tiers listed as Level 1 up to 100 downloads (15%) through Level 6 above 25,000 (40%); commentary on the January reset dropping a Level 4 contributor (30%) back to 15%. Opinion/commentary. Page not opened.

sources.title: Shutterstock faces D-Day backlash over rate cuts
sources.notes: Search summary: 2020 contributor backlash to Shutterstock's royalty cuts. The specific claim that a typical subscription download fell from $0.25–$0.38 to $0.10–$0.14 came from the summary and was not pinned to this article. Page not opened.
